audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Alex’s memorial event for his mother and Sebastian’s rainy-beach event. Every spoken line, response option, memory, grief beat, keepsake and relationship line was reviewed in full event context with canonical gridball terminology and natural character voices. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, response IDs, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining Beach records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
